name: Kodak Aerocolor IV 2460
note: Dye gammas are this stock's own, read off its maker's published characteristic curve. Nothing here is measured from a roll. Read from the sheet's Low Contrast panel, C-41 at 3'15", the standard C-41 development time. Also sold as SantaColor 100, Flic Film Elektra 100 and Karmir 160, whose sellers each say it is this film. The window stays on Kodak's printed lux-second axis. The sheet's speed point sits about one stop fast of ISO 100, but the only speed it prints is an aerial film speed, EAFS or ISO A 125, which Kodak says is not a conventional film speed, so there is nothing valid to anchor it to.
